meta.name: reticle
meta.description: Install, instrument and verify this running web app from the inside (DOM, network, routing, console and framework state) instead of screenshots or guessing. Drives one real flow end to end and returns a verdict with the file:line to fix. Use when the user asks to set up or install Reticle, when a user-facing change needs proving before you call it done, when a test passes but the UI is broken, or when the user types /reticle.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 跑通一遍真实用户操作流程,拿到哪里出问题、该改哪一行代码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果代码改完想确认页面真的没坏,却不知道从哪查起。
copy.tagline_en: Run one real user flow in the browser and get the failing file and line to fix
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a code change needs proving the page still works before you ship.

howto.what: 它会自动在你的网页应用里装上 Reticle(仅开发环境),替你真实走完一条用户流程,最后给出结论,并指出要修改的文件和行号。
howto.when: 当你要求安装或设置 Reticle、面向用户的改动需要在上线前被验证、或测试通过但界面实际是坏的等情况时接手;输入 /reticle 也会触发。

say.text: 给这个项目装上 Reticle,并验证一条真实流程
say.note: 先跑 init,再做首次流程验证

say.text: 检查我的改动有没有破坏已有流程
say.note: 返回结论和要修的 file:line

howto.what_en: Installs a dev-only Reticle SDK into your running web app, drives one real user flow end to end, and returns a verdict plus the file:line to fix.
howto.when_en: Use when you ask to set up Reticle, when a user-facing change needs proving before you call it done, or when a test passes but the UI is broken; /reticle also triggers it.

say_en.text: Install Reticle in this project and verify a real flow
say_en.note: Runs init, then the first-run verification

say_en.text: Check whether my change broke any existing flow
say_en.note: Returns a verdict and the file:line to fix
Triggers the skill via slash command
